entities.summary: The University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna, or BOKU University, is a public university in Vienna, Austria. No consensus has yet been established on the university's name in English. While the university calls itself the BOKU University and the University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna, Austria's Federal Ministry of Women, Science and Research calls it the University of Natural Resources and Applied Life Sciences Vienna.
